'''Iron rocks''' are a type of protruding rock that contains [[iron ore]]. Players with a [[Mining]] level of 15 or higher can mine iron ore from rocks found in various [[List of mines|mines]], granting 35 Mining [[experience]] for each ore mined. After being mined, an iron rock takes 5.4 seconds to [[respawn]]. When inside the [[members]]' area of the [[Mining Guild]], that time is reduced to 2.4 seconds; the faster respawn time makes it the best place to [[Pay-to-play Mining training#Fastest experience|power-mine]] iron, with an experience rate of up to 70k xp/h. 

Iron is the most popular ore that [[free-to-play]] players power-mine for experience. For locations where there are three rocks in a triangle formation suitable for proper power-mining, see [[Iron rocks#Power-mining Locations|here]].

Wearing [[mining gloves]], [[superior mining gloves]], or [[expert mining gloves]] makes the rock not deplete upon mining iron, allowing players to mine one, two, or three additional ore, respectively, before depleting.

The rocks in [[the Node mine]] provide iron ore, but no experience past level 3 Mining. As the rocks require level 15 to mine, it is impossible under standard conditions to receive experience.
